text:
acme_ops: Hi — SSO started failing around 09:30 UTC for our org (AcmeCorp). Users get a 403 at the ACS endpoint and our IdP rotation happened yesterday. Error we see in browser: 'SAML_RESPONSE_REPLAY'. Pasting SAMLResponse (redacted) and metadata URL: https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml

mira: Thanks, can you paste the raw base64 SAMLResponse (or attach) and the metadata? Want to check signing and InResponseTo fields.

acme_ops: posted blob in DM. metadata is at the link above. No other changes on our side.

sam: Quick triage from our logs: signature verification succeeds but replay check fails. Log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T09:31:12Z] tenant=acme request_id=abc123 SAML verify=ok replay_check=fail reason="missing InResponseTo in SubjectConfirmationData"
```

mira: I decoded the SAMLResponse they sent. The IdP is currently signing the <Response> (SignedResponse) and NOT the Assertion. Our consumer typically expects a signed Assertion (or at least an Assertion that contains SubjectConfirmationData with InResponseTo). In this payload the Assertion lacks SubjectConfirmationData/@InResponseTo so our replay protection has nothing to match and we reject.

lee_oncall: We've seen this pattern before when IdP rotation scripts flip signing options. Two remediation options:
1) Ask the IdP admin to switch signing back to the Assertion (recommended). Also ensure metadata contains a KeyDescriptor with use="signing" for the new cert.
2) Temporarily enable tenant-level "accept_signed_response" behavior so we verify the Response signature and accept the Assertion even if InResponseTo is missing. This is a bigger trust surface and needs approval.

julie_se: I'll draft the customer-facing steps. Mira — can you put exact repro commands we can hand them to validate?

mira: Repro/checklist for customer (copy-paste):
1) Save the SAMLResponse to a file: `echo \"<base64-payload>\" > resp.b64`
2) Decode: `base64 -d resp.b64 > resp.xml`
3) Pretty-print: `xmllint --format resp.xml`
4) Verify whether Response/Assertion is signed: `xmllint --xpath \"boolean(//ds:Signature[../local-name()\='Response'\])\" resp.xml` and `xmllint --xpath \"boolean(//ds:Signature[../local-name()\='Assertion'\])\" resp.xml`
5) Check for InResponseTo: `xmllint --xpath \"string(//saml:SubjectConfirmationData/@InResponseTo)\" resp.xml` (empty = missing)
6) Check metadata for signing cert: `curl -s https://idp.acme.example/metadata.xml | xmllint --xpath \"string(//KeyDescriptor[@use\='signing']/ds:X509Certificate)\" -`

sam: If customer cannot change IdP quickly, I can prepare a tenant toggle that will accept Response-signed SAML. It will: verify Response signature, log an audit event, and skip strict InResponseTo replay check. Need acme_ops explicit opt-in.

acme_ops: We prefer the IdP change. We'll ask our IdP admin to switch back to signing the Assertion and upload fresh metadata with the new signing cert. ETA ~2 hours.

lee_oncall: 👍 I'll queue the tenant toggle as a standby. Sam — don't enable it until they explicitly request. We'll also add a short note in the tenant audit when it's used.

julie_se: Draft reply ready, will send once acme_ops confirms. Thanks team.

support-bot: Incident created #INC-2026-3234 and linked to this thread.
